name: Neighbors by Chance
source: Yuuhi’s days are dull and grey, brightened only by the gacha game she plays religiously. She avoids everyone—even the new neighbor next door—until she can’t anymore, and she learns that said neighbor is… her long-lost best friend from third grade?!
translation: Yuuhi的日子沉闷而灰暗，只有她虔诚地玩扭蛋游戏才让她变得明亮。她避开所有人——甚至是隔壁的新邻居——直到她再也无法躲避为止，她得知那个邻居是……她三年级时失散多年的最好的朋友？！
